full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph looks sharply upward along a tall, symmetrical Art Deco facade against a nearly black sky. The lower edge is filled by large pale vertical piers that rise past the viewer, their shallow ridges and grooves leading into the height of the building. In the center, a narrow dark shaft of recessed windows is framed by broad bright stone strips. The central section climbs farther than the flanking wings and finishes in a small cluster of stepped projections near the upper middle. On the left and right, two massive wings angle away from the viewpoint, each lined with repeated window bays and long pale ribs. Their upper edges are trimmed into successive setbacks, producing a tiered silhouette rather than a flat roof line. The camera's low position makes these parallel lines seem to converge overhead, giving the central tower a pronounced vertical thrust. Dark window rectangles interrupt the pale wall at regular intervals, but the repeated ribs carry the strongest visual rhythm. Surface detail is restrained: subtle stone joints and slight differences in gray remain visible beneath the hard graphic division between sunlit planes and shadowed slots. A broad area of smooth charcoal sky occupies the top of the picture and isolates the geometric crown. The light appears to come from above and a little to the left, lifting the outer stone bands to bright gray while the window recesses and the deeper spaces between wings stay near black. There is no visible street activity, person, sign, or readable text; the image concentrates entirely on scale, elevation, and repeated structure. The overall composition is severe and upward-sweeping, using symmetry, stepped edges, and high monochrome contrast to turn the facade into a pattern of ascending lines.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白建筑照片从陡峭仰角观看一座高大、对称的装饰艺术立面，背后是近乎黑色的天空。下边缘被巨大的浅色竖向壁柱占满，它们从观者身旁向上升起，浅浅的棱脊和凹槽把视线引向建筑高处。中央一条后退的深色窗带由宽阔明亮的石材条带围住。中间部分比两侧翼楼攀升得更高，并在上方中央形成一小组层阶式突出体。左右两侧，厚重翼楼从视点向外倾展，各自排列重复的窗格和长长的浅色竖肋。它们的顶边逐级退让，形成阶梯轮廓而非平直屋顶。相机的低位置让这些平行线看起来在头顶汇聚，使中央高塔产生强烈的向上冲势。深色矩形窗以规律间距打断浅墙，但重复的竖肋形成最强视觉节奏。表面细节克制：细微的石材接缝和灰阶差别仍可见，明亮平面与阴影槽之间则有鲜明的图形分界。一大片平滑的炭灰天空占据图片上方，使几何冠部独立显现。光似乎从上方略偏左侧照来，让外层石条变成亮灰色，窗洞以及翼楼之间更深的空间几乎全黑。没有可见街道活动、人物、标牌或可读文字；画面全心关注尺度、高度和重复结构。整体构图严峻而向上席卷，以对称、层阶边缘和强烈黑白反差将立面化为不断攀升的线条图案。
style_prompt_en: The image has a black-and-white photographic finish with a forceful low-angle perspective and a disciplined vertical rhythm. Tall pale bands alternate with dark recessed slots, while repeated small rectangular openings measure the rise of the larger forms. Setbacks and narrow projecting ribs create a stepped silhouette whose edges stay crisp against a broad charcoal field. The tonal range is compressed into bright silver-gray planes, medium gray joints, and almost black voids, with little decorative color or soft atmospheric blur. Smooth stone or concrete surfaces retain slight seams and weather variation, but pattern and mass dominate texture. Light from above catches exposed ridges and leaves the cavities dense and dark. Symmetry organizes the central thrust, while angled side masses stretch perspective toward the upper frame. The overall effect is monumental, graphic, and emphatically upward, with rhythm emerging from repeated linear relief and stark value separation.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现黑白摄影质感，以强劲的低角度透视和严谨竖向节奏为核心。高耸的浅色条带与深暗凹槽交替，重复的小型矩形开口为大形体的上升标出尺度。退台与狭窄外凸的竖肋形成层阶式剪影，边缘在宽阔的炭灰色域前保持清楚。明度范围集中在亮银灰平面、中灰接缝和近乎黑色的空隙，几乎没有柔软的大气模糊。光滑石材或混凝土表面保留轻微接缝与风化变化，但图案和体量压过纹理。上方来光照亮外露棱脊，让凹处浓重而暗。对称组织中央向上冲势，两侧倾斜的体量则把透视拉向画面上缘。整体效果宏伟、图形化并强烈向上，其节奏来自反复的线性起伏与鲜明明度分离。
theme_en: A monochrome upward view between the stepped wings of a tall Art Deco facade
theme_zh: 从层阶式装饰艺术立面两翼之间仰望的黑白画面
name: Art Deco architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
